_about: Corrections and additions to the Wikipedia-drafted TUF season files, each backed by an official UFC source. The drafter (scripts/tuf/import_season.mjs) re-applies this ledger after every draft, so re-importing a season cannot silently undo a sourced repair. Applied by scripts/tuf/apply_official_repairs.mjs, which refuses a repair whose 'expect' no longer matches rather than overwriting a value it did not check.

_policy.precedence: An official UFC source (ufc.com recap or event page) outranks the Wikipedia draft for the fields it states. Wikipedia stays the discovery source and the provenance of every field the official source does not state.
_policy.contradictions: When the official source contradicts itself, the value its corroborating statements support is kept and the contradiction is written into the season's _conflicts. Nothing ambiguous is overwritten silently.
_policy.dates: episode, air_date and fight_date are separate facts. A recap's publish time is not an air date and is never used as one.
